## Trust and verification notes

- **Private-source behavior:** only entries marked sourceAccess = public render a source button. Entries marked hidden keep sourceUrl empty.
- **ScholarHub:** five existing promotional PNG graphics were copied from /home/kali/screenshort/playstore-graphics. The production homepage at https://scholarhub-test.vercel.app/ responded during verification; the source repository is intentionally not linked.
- **HackerAI:** the hackerai-main repository homepage returned HTTP 404 during the connected web audit, so its live button is withheld. A corrected public URL is needed.
- **Hacker gf AI:** the Vercel alias returned content, but its canonical metadata named a different host. Its current URL should be confirmed by the owner before treating it as the final canonical deployment.
- **Personal Website — Design Concept:** the inspected landing page contains placeholder metrics and testimonial-style copy. It is labelled as a concept, not real client evidence.
- **Sourov Works Pentest Lab:** repository README describes a deliberately vulnerable target and recommends isolation/synthetic data. The public-preview link is intentionally withheld pending confirmation of deployment isolation.
- **ARVEN / STELE:** the live experiences identify themselves as fictional concept studies; the cards preserve those caveats.
- **Active Theory V6 Rebuild:** the README documents a reconstruction with full visual parity still unverified on hardware-accelerated WebGL 2.
- **CYBEROS:** repository README describes the UI as partial/mock and not yet API integrated.
- **VercStorm:** its README currently has no substantive project overview, so the gallery says documentation is needed.

## Known inventory limitation

No private repositories were returned by the current connected repository inventory. Private-project entries need the approved title/description and the exact, verified HTTPS live deployment URL supplied by the owner. Never paste private GitHub URLs into this public catalog.

For updating entries, use [PRIVATE_PROJECTS.md](PRIVATE_PROJECTS.md) and [ASSET_GUIDELINES.md](ASSET_GUIDELINES.md).
